title: Dr Bug: 'we can't take your soul'

tellings.quote:
what the
bug Dr bug told me which
is we can't take your soul

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, says he was taken by an alien being he calls "Dr Bug," and that it told him, "we can't take your soul." Blitch tells Michels this as something he lived through, and if true it would mean such beings admit a limit to what they can do to people.
